In mathematics, a '''CH-quasigroup''', introduced by {{harvtxt|Manin|1986|loc=definition 1.3}}, is a symmetric [[quasigroup]] in which any three elements generate an abelian quasigroup.  "CH" stands for [[cubic hypersurface]].
